| # Logging in BSW {#logging-in-bsw-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                 |                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This section details the secure logging features implemented by the BSW concerning parameter management and security access. These logs provide transparency and diagnostic information regarding configuration changes and security attempts.

## Logged Events {#logged-events .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The ECU logs events related to parameter modifications, security access attempts, and configuration management. These logs help track what changes occurred and whether any unauthorized operation was attempted.

### Parameter‑Related Events {#parameterrelated-events .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The following events are logged whenever ECU parameters are modified or managed:

- Successful Parameter Writing: Logged when parameters are successfully updated using WriteDataByIdentifier (WDBI).

- Saving Parameters to NVM: Logged when the "Save Parameters to NVM" routine completes successfully (Routine ID: 0xF000, Sub‑function: 0x01).

- Setting Parameters to Default Values: Logged when the "Set Parameters to Default Values" routine completes successfully (Routine ID: 0xF001, Sub‑function: 0x01).

### Security‑Related Events {#securityrelated-events .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

These logs help identify unauthorized or failed security access attempts:

- Incorrect Security Access Password: Logged when Security Access (Service 0x27) fails due to an incorrect password.

- Security Access Denied (WDBI): Logged when a WDBI request (Service 0x2E) is denied with NRC 0x33.

- Security Access Denied (RoutineControl): Logged when a RoutineControl request (Service 0x31) is denied with NRC 0x33 for the following operations:

oAttempting to save parameters to NVM

oAttempting to set parameters to default values

## Timestamp Logging {#timestamp-logging .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The ECU records timestamps to maintain a clear history of configuration changes. Timestamps are stored whenever:

- A parameter is successfully changed using WDBI.

- The Save Parameters to NVM routine completes successfully.

- The Set Parameters to Default Values routine completes successfully.

## Accessing Logged Timestamps {#accessing-logged-timestamps .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

Diagnostic tools can retrieve timestamp data using specific DID.

DID 0xFE22 --- Last Configuration Change Timestamp

- 4‑byte value (in minutes)

- Indicates when parameters were last successfully modified

## Reading the Last Flashing Date {#reading-the-last-flashing-date .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

Users can retrieve the date of the most recent successful software flashing via a diagnostic request.

DID 0xF199 --- Last Flashing Date

- Read‑only parameter

- Indicates the date of the last successful flashing event

- Returned as an 8‑byte hexadecimal value representing DDMMYYYY

## Diagnostic Fault Codes (DFCs) {#diagnostic-fault-codes-dfcs .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  DTC Code   DFC name                                                                   Description
  ---------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  0x220800   [DFC_rbr_secInvalidPassword](diagnostic-trouble-code.html){.topiclink}     Incorrect password during Security Access (Service 0x27).
  0x220A00   [DFC_rbr_secAccessDenied_WDBI](diagnostic-trouble-code.html){.topiclink}   WDBI (Service 0x2E) denied due to insufficient security access (NRC 0x33).
  0x220B00   [DFC_rbr_secAccessDenied_RC](diagnostic-trouble-code.html){.topiclink}     RoutineControl (Service 0x31) denied due to insufficient security access (NRC 0x33), applicable to saving parameters to NVM or setting parameters to default values.
